abilities.descEn: Some of the Mineral used to produce that Ranger is restored when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時可回收一部份生產該Ranger時所消耗的礦物。

abilities.descEn: Occasionally avoids the effects of Tornado and Thunderstorm items.
abilities.descZh: 該Ranger能夠在一定機率下閃避「龍捲風／大雷雨」的道具效果。

abilities.descEn: Sometimes 1 additional Ranger is produced at no extra cost.
abilities.descZh: 以一定機率只消耗生產1隻Ranger所需的礦物量就生產出2隻Ranger。

abilities.descEn: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
abilities.descZh: 出動擁有此能力的Ranger時，能以高機率將敵方隊伍1隻Ranger的重新產生時間量表凍結一定時間。此能力可於戰鬥開始10秒後發動。
